---
description: Show the plan, Merkle graph (Mermaid) and interview history
agent: agent
---

Run `automagic show` and present `.automagic/plan/plan.md`, including the Mermaid graph. Use `automagic show --node <id>` to explain a node's hash chain. `automagic show --open` opens `.automagic/plan/plan.html`, where work items are ticked and prerequisites are selected automatically.
